items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: his name was Joe James... Joe taught me everything, trumpet

ctx.x: Yes, something like that and his girl-friends were snatching people so I didn't -- I wanted to know what was happening and Joe was saying now, now, you -- he used to call me Him all the time, so -- I was getting myself together you know, I was learning - and one chick come in there and I'm looking too and he says get away from this bandstand because she had made it possible for another fellow to have died by
request, so she said, after all, I can look and he's nice -- get away from here, and Joe got up and put a little flesh upside that child's head and she didn't come near that bandstand anymore.
